title: Intact credential bytes divided between stream chunks
summary: The bytes of one intact SendGrid-shaped key are divided between chunks of a stream or string at a chosen boundary; no byte of the key is changed.
rationale: Chunking is delivery, not text fragmentation: the concatenated bytes equal the base key and no separator is inside it, so the key is the same credential and the expected range is the same bytes. A boundary inside a multibyte character before the key does not move the key. Distinct from every line-break Case because nothing in the text is split by a separator.

expectation.rationale: Flagged. The input is the base key unchanged (the same bytes), so its outcome follows from the family's documented key length and from the pinned open-source rules that are consistent with the key shape; a chunk boundary is data about delivery, not part of the value. How a product reassembles chunks is the product's behaviour and is not asserted here. Synthetic, never issued: every value in the fixtures is built from the words SYNTHETIC and EXAMPLE, so none can authenticate.

sources.supports: SendGrid API keys are always 69 characters long.
gitleaks 8.30.1 rule is consistent with the SG. two-segment base62 shape (as already recorded in the family's contract).
trufflehog 3.97.4 sendgrid detector is consistent with the SG. two-segment shape (as already recorded in the family's contract).
